svg.aria-label: The path: one lane per row of the set, against time, with a now line at September 21, 2026. A ship-fence band under the axis reads LIFTED on September 20 — the W3 floor is Done and W4's first cut landed, so children may open implementation pull requests, not only specs. Two input lanes from other epics carry bars that reach the now line: the W3 floor FIX-1351, landed, giving seats, channels and skills on disk; and the W4 first cut FIX-1407, landed, giving boards, inventory and dispatch policy, with two strays still in backlog that are not part of the first cut. Then the five lanes of the set. Two of them now carry a bar, because a bar means a row has its first pull request open: FIX-1429, serving the file-declared demo, is in review on pull request 1989 with its goal check passing, and FIX-1478, the patterns shed, is in spec review on pull request 1988 with its collapse trigger contested. The remaining three are drawn as a dashed line with no bar, because nothing has opened for them. FIX-1475, durable hire, does not open until FIX-1429 closes, so its dashed line begins to the right of the others. FIX-1476, channels and boards, and FIX-1477, the UI package split, are both held short of spec on D8's sign-off; FIX-1477's lane runs longest because it absorbs the other rows' surfaces as they land rather than waiting for them. The critical path is drawn in the gutter as two linked dots on FIX-1429 and FIX-1475, the only hard chain in the set. Under a divider, three related lanes that are not in the set: the parked channel-admin capability FIX-1415, the manager-queue lab FIX-1430 consumed as a POC spine, and org-never-optional FIX-1442, soft-related. A final note records the owner's September 20 triage of five stale kitchen-sink tickets: FIX-1372 stays open and is verified at wrap, while FIX-420, FIX-429, FIX-472 and FIX-540 close as superseded by this set. None of the five is a child of this epic.
